goal: LINQ performance review: queries evaluated in memory, repeated enumeration and avoidable allocations.
use: LINQ performance review: queries evaluated in memory, repeated enumeration and avoidable allocations. Use when a LINQ query runs over large or frequent data.

steps.note: List the queries on hot paths or large data.
Check where evaluation happens. Flag work done in memory that the database could do.
Check repeated enumeration. Flag a query enumerated several times.
Check allocations. Flag repeated ToList calls on the same data.
Report. Each query with its cost, file and line, and the fix.
